fonts.installation_instruction: Import via Google Fonts or standard next/font methods

spacing_and_layout.filter_bar: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-[#121212]/80 border border-[#27272A] p-3 rounded-2xl sticky top-20 z-40 backdrop-blur-xl
spacing_and_layout.kpi_cards: p-6 rounded-2xl bg-[#121212] border border-[#27272A] relative overflow-hidden group flex flex-col justify-between

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass: bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 sticky top-0 z-50
surface_strategies.kpi_primary: The 'Tracing Beam': For the main 'Activated Subscriptions' KPI, add a subtle glowing border effect or an inner drop-shadow.
surface_strategies.floating_ai: Glassmorphism pill: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(230,0,0,0.15)] bottom-6 right-6 fixed

components.navigation_tabs: Floating pill menu. Wrap the 8 tabs in a scrollable horizontal flex container. bg-zinc-900/50 p-1 rounded-full border border-white/5. Active tab gets bg-zinc-800 text-white. Use framer-motion layoutId for the sliding active background.
components.kpi_numbers: text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-outfit font-semibold tracking-tighter text-white mt-4 mb-1
components.buttons: Action buttons (Actualiser, Comparaison, etc.) grouped in an icon-first toolbar. bg-[#121212] border border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-600 transition-all shadow-sm
components.charts: Recharts Area/Bar charts. Minimalist. Remove standard grids. Use faint strokeDasharray lines for Y-axis only. Gradients under Area lines using <defs><linearGradient>.
components.data_tables: Minimalist layout. Horizontal borders only (border-b border-zinc-800). text-sm for data, uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.1em] text-zinc-500 for headers.

animations.kpi_entrance: Staggered fade-up with framer-motion (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1)
animations.tabs: Framer motion shared layout animation for the active state pill

images.description: Subtle dark noise/texture. Place absolutely behind the dashboard wrapper at 3-5% opacity to break the flat black.

icons.instruction: Use Duotone or Regular weights. Essential for telecom metrics (Signal, Users, ChartLineUp, Storefront).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for all iconography.
Install and use framer-motion for tab transitions, hover effects, and KPI entrance animations.
Install recharts for the analytics visualizations.
Fix the UI/UX problem: Completely eliminate the 40% height white-space of the old date filters. Collapse them into a single horizontal toolbar below the main header.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the main content (dense, highly utilized space).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (tabs, filters, buttons, AI widget).

Use standard Shadcn UI primitives (Tables, Popovers, Calendars) but heavily customize their Tailwind classes to match this ultra-dark premium theme (override pure white backgrounds to #121212 and apply zinc-800 borders).
Ensure 'Outfit' font is used for KPIs and Headings, 'Manrope' for body data.
